In its place, several other animal species had the opportunity to evolve and occupy the top of the food chain. In this world, the future is the present, and the power struggle is even more intense. Certain species dominate large corporations, while others live forgotten in the underworld. Welcome to the Persona non Grata universe. In it you take on the mantle of a hacker willing to dismantle this model of tyrannical society. To do this, you will need to gather information about the corrupt employees of the biggest corporations, sharing them and stealing them from your opponents. The game rounds are played simultaneously: You must select an information card, link to one of your action cards (download, send or encrypt) and pass the rest of the information cards in your hand to the next player. After all the information has been played, players compare the relevance of their information in each corporation. The first two places can score, stealing information cards from other players. At the end of 3 rounds, we will count the points. But be careful, to score in each corporation you will need to activate them with worker cards or headquarters. Discover Board Game Arena Rules summary The Game Round - All players play simultaneously. - Each turn (day), players select one Information card and one Action card and place them face down. After revealing, they execute their actions: Download: Reveal and place the Information card in your play area. Encrypt: Place the Information card face down in your play area. Send (Left or Right): Reveal and place the Information card in the player’s play area to your left or right, respectively. - Players pass remaining Information cards to the next player (clockwise/counterclockwise based on the week). - The week ends after all Action cards are used. Last card in hand is discarded. Archiving Information - Reveal all Encrypted cards. - Compare relevance points of Information cards for each corporation. - First-place player archives the top Corporation card; second-place player takes the Key card. - If a tie occurs, the player with the Key decides the winner. End of the Game - The game ends after three weeks. - All remaining Information cards are archived. - Players gather archived cards, activating corporations with an Activator (any Corporation card or Worker). - Score based on activated cards and Key cards (1 point each). - The player with the highest reputation points wins. Tiebreakers are the number of activated corporations, then Key cards, and finally sharing the victory.
